issues.on_page: Other local receipts 258,315.47 (General 2,795.00 + Other Governmental 255,520.47, p4)
issues.issue: By the fund schedules, Other Governmental 'Other local receipts' 255,520.47 = School Nutrition sales/misc 80,701.93 (p14) + Special Building misc 6,081.15 (p16) + Activities Fund 168,737.39 (p13 receipts 293,334.14 less 25,000 transfer, 97,384.22 contributions and 2,212.53 interest). Activity receipts are about 65% of the line, so under the >half rule it should be Extracurricular Receipts (or split with split_from); charges for services/fees is no longer the category for school activity or lunch receipts.
Non-reimbursable (a la carte) meal sales are School Lunch Sales, not reimbursements; the line's own detail_category is already school lunch sales

issues.on_page: Activities Fund receipts 293,334.14 (includes 25,000 transfer from General Fund, p24)
issues.issue: The contra line reduces Activities Fund receipts, which are all Extracurricular Receipts; categorised as charges for services/fees it understates that category by 25,000 and overstates Extracurricular Receipts by 25,000

Exhibit P 'Capital Assets' object lines (also detail[87] 2,299.00, detail[106] 39,748.67, detail[122] 15,000.00, detail[129] 8,827.00) are capital purchases; the user rule puts every capital outlay line inside a function in category capital outlay
The 25,000 transfer to the Activity Fund is printed on p24; the line is marked computed from p4/p14 but could cite p24 directly
